turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
Take your time.
The money worry is still there, we may need to cut our car insurance and the gym.
Mm-hm. Go on.
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. I think so, yes.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today.
Tell me more about that.
The headteacher agreed to extend my maternity leave until the January term.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. That is how it was.
Mm-hm. Go on.
Tom told me he is exhausted too and wants us to share the mornings more.
What happened next?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. It is not easy to talk about.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
How did that feel for you?
Sophie and I went for coffee after the group and her baby is the same age as Oliver.
Tell me more about that.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. I think so, yes.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
